question_patterns: why do I sneeze so much
en.first_sentence: This is a sneeze! Tickly dust makes your nose blow air out.
facts: Tiny hairs inside your nose can catch dust.
Flower dust or a sick germ can also tickle your nose.
When you sneeze, air rushes out very fast.
